title: THE FIRST SCENE WASN'T A BREAKTHROUGH
passages: One of the earliest scenes is me trying a machine at the gym, laughing because I don't really know if I'm doing it right. That matters to the story. Before the big declarations, before the runway and the new skills, there was someone willing to look a little ridiculous and enjoy himself anyway.

Then December brought the harder question: how much longer was I willing to live inside a version of myself I had already outgrown? I wanted a different life. I was beginning to understand that wanting it would have to become something I practiced.
